fields.weeks: NFL weeks (the last N played weeks league-wide; a bye or absence is null)
fields.tgt: player targets / team targets that week (0-1)
fields.car: player carries / team carries that week (0-1)
fields.routes: not published: route counts are not in public nflverse data

attribution: nflverse (nflverse-data releases): weekly player stats, snap counts, rosters, play-by-play

unavailable_fields.routes: public nflverse data has no route counts; shown as absent rather than estimated

notes: Descriptive usage by week. Whether recent share predicts the next game is tested separately in the validation journal, not claimed here.
Team totals use every player row in the stats file for that team-week, so shares sum to <= 1 over listed players.
Players are listed when they reached an 8% target share, a 12% carry share (QBs: a 50% snap share) in any listed week.
